RESPONSIBILITIES:

Planning Management:

• Process and monitor information related to incoming goods received via email; manage the inbound mailbox.
• Schedule truck deliveries via email and telephone.
• Enter all announced shipments into planning files/Excel.
• Prepare and monitor mid- to long-term planning and forecasts (FCST).
• Maintain oversight of delivery schedules, slot bookings, and warehouse capacity utilization.
• Proactively solve problems and provide recommendations to Planning, Operations, Carriers, and Transport Management.
 

Receiving Operations:

• Create ASNs (Advance Shipping Notices) and Inbound Deliveries.
• Enter Purchase Orders (POs) into SAP, manage the Delivery Due List, and create inbound deliveries.
• Verify shipment labels and ensure control over the origin of goods and batches.
• Maintain, update, and analyze master data.
• Communicate with customs brokers regarding import and export customs clearance procedures.
• Initiate packaging adjustments to optimize logistics processes.
 

Continuous Improvement:

• Continuously assess opportunities for process improvement.
• Contribute ideas to optimize inbound goods flows, including transportation, booking slots, and packaging.
• Prepare reports on KPIs, carrier performance, packaging usage, and related metrics.
• Coordinate with carriers and suppliers when KPI targets are not achieved.
 

Driver Reception Desk:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for truck drivers; assign gates and manage check-in/check-out through the slot booking system.
• Process, create, and manage CMRs, packing lists, invoices, and export documentation for both incoming and outgoing AM/OE shipments.
• Provide drivers with all required documentation.
• Perform administrative tasks.
• Print locator labels and tickets.
• Resolve operational issues and exceptions.
 

Outbound (Backup Support):

• Create deliveries based on Excel files, emails, or SAP follow-up activities.
• Determine picking priorities based on collection schedules while considering warehouse picking capacity.
• Release and coordinate transportation for ICY shipments within and outside Europe.
• Release and monitor transportation activities for the French market.
• Arrange and track transportation for DACH, Nordic, Benelux, and other markets.
• Resolve issues related to transportation, goods, and materials.
• Act as the communication link between Customer Service, Operations, and Carriers.
• Analyze and follow up on transportation claims in C4C.

• Knowledge of warehouse processes, inbound operations, and picking techniques
• Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Proficiency in SAP, Microsoft Office, and slot booking systems.
• Able to work independently, in a structured manner, and under pressure.
• Strong communication skills.
• Customer-oriented mindset.
• Continuous improvement mentality.
• Team player.
• Strong focus on safety and compliance with regulations.
• Preferred: Experience in spare parts inventory management.

You will spend around 90% of your time in the field. Working with a colleague, you will carry out maintenance, inspections and technical interventions on specialised installations in the rail environment. Most assignments are in Antwerp, Brussels and Ghent, with additional interventions elsewhere. 
 
• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on technical installations. 
• Analyse and resolve mechanical, electromechanical and electrical faults. 
• Assess technical situations independently and help determine the appropriate course of action. 
• Carry out measurements, inspections and interventions using professional tools and test equipment. 
• Liaise with colleagues, engineers and project managers. 
• Depending on your experience, coordinate activities and take a leading role in the field.  
Rail experience is an advantage, but not essential. You bring a solid technical background and relevant practical experience; Buhlmann will teach you the specific installations, procedures and safety requirements of the rail environment. Experience in industrial maintenance, machine building, installation engineering or field service can be highly relevant.
 
After your induction period, you will take part in the on-call rota. Urgent night-time interventions are limited to a few occasions per year. In addition, there is on average around one planned night intervention per month, with time off in lieu afterwards.

We are looking for an experienced technician who knows the trade, can tackle technical problems independently and takes responsibility for safe, high-quality execution. 
 
• Technical qualification in electromechanics, mechanics, electricity, or equivalent experience. 
• Several years of relevant practical experience in maintenance, industrial installations, machine building, field service or a comparable technical environment. 
• Strong foundation in mechanics and electromechanics, complemented by sufficient electrical knowledge. 
• You analyse problems methodically, work independently and consult others when the situation requires it. 
• You enjoy field work and are comfortable in a role involving travel to different sites. 
• Experience as a lead technician, team leader or site supervisor is an advantage; even in such a role, you still want to remain technically involved. 
• You can communicate operationally in Dutch and/or French and have sufficient English for technical communication.

As Office Manager, you will be at the heart of the Brussels office, ensuring that everything runs smoothly. You will combine service excellence and operational responsibility whilst working closely with local and international teams to support the day-to-day running of the office and contribute to wider firm initiatives. 

Your Responsibilities
  
• Manage facilities and office services, ensuring the workplace is well equipped, maintained and ready to support colleagues' daily work.  
• Shape the workplace and employee experience to support team growth by identifying practical opportunities to make the Brussels office more welcoming, efficient and well organised.  
• Lead and develop the reception team, creating a high-quality experience for colleagues, clients and visitors. 
• In collaboration with diverse stakeholders (HR, IT, Marketing, the Social Committee as well as international teams) coordinate and deliver office projects and events including client seminars and team building initiatives  
• Build and manage strong supplier relationships, ensuring quality service and value for money.  
• Contribute to Health & Safety, Security, Risk Management, Business Continuity and GDPR  helping maintain a safe and supportive workplace.  
• Encourage ESG initiatives and contribute to the firm's sustainability objectives in Brussels.  
• Participate in the global Office Management quarterly meetings, sharing best practices and bringing innovative ideas to the Brussels office.  
 
• You have minimum 5 years' experience in Office Management and an interest in how office management is evolving through new systems and technologies.  
• Excellent English, with good knowledge of Dutch and French 
• A proactive and motivating leadership style. 
• Clear and confident communication skills. 
• A collaborative "one team" mindset, enabling you to build strong working relationships. 
• Integrity, professionalism and a strong sense of ownership. 
• A creative and practical approach to problem-solving.

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.

You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.

Client Details

An organisation based in Zaventem operating within the property sector.

Description

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.

You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.

This role goes beyond pure administration. You work within structured procedures, but you also think proactively, communicate clearly, and help ensure that everything runs efficiently in a service-driven environment.

 

What you will do

• Act as the main contact person for business partners and internal teams within the sales support scope
• Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team
• Register, process, and follow up on requests and applications through the full workflow, including validation with financial partners
• Manage customer and partner communication via email and web portal, ensuring speed, clarity, and professionalism
• Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Order Processing, Finance, and Operations
• Prepare and manage documents using structured templates and standardized procedures
• Monitor incoming and outgoing requests, documentation, and order statuses, and proactively resolve issues
• Ensure strict compliance with internal procedures and company policies, working in a detailed and precise manner
• Support the onboarding of new business partners, guiding them through tools, processes, and ways of working
• Maintain an overview of contracts, ongoing files, and partnership-related communication
• Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and communication
 

What you bring to the table

• At least 2 years of experience in a sales support, administrative, or coordination role
• Experience in service-oriented environments such as banking, insurance, leasing, or similar sectors is a strong asset
• A structured and process-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail
• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
• Strong communication skills, with a customer- and partner-oriented approach
• Ability to work independently, while also thriving in a close-knit team where collaboration is key
• Languages: Very good knowledge of Dutch or French, with professional working knowledge of the other language
• English is a plus
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools and web-based applications
• No advanced financial calculations required; a basic understanding of financial concepts is sufficient

The successful candidate will maintain positive relationships with clients, legal professionals, and internal stakeholders while ensuring the highest level of confidentiality at all times.

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong presence in Brussels. They are currently seeking an experienced Management Assistant to provide high-level administrative and organisational support to a team of lawyers within a fast-paced and demanding environment.

 

Description

As a Management Assistant, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the legal team by providing comprehensive administrative support.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing complex calendars and coordinating meetings.
• Organising domestic and international travel arrangements.
• Assisting with client onboarding and matter opening processes.
• Supporting billing and expense management activities.
• Drafting, proofreading, formatting and finalising legal documents and correspondence.
• Managing document filing and record-keeping systems.
• Handling incoming calls, emails, and correspondence professionally.
• Coordinating meeting rooms and related services, including catering and IT support.
• Liaising with internal departments and external stakeholders.
• Ensuring a high level of confidentiality and professionalism at all times.
• Providing general administrative support and assisting with ad hoc projects.

 

• Strong previous experience as a Management Assistant, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
• Excellent organisational and multitasking skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint).
• Experience with document management systems is an advantage.
• Fluent English, together with French and/or Dutch.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Professional, proactive and service-oriented mindset.
• Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Flexible and adaptable approach in a fast-paced environment.

Our client is looking for a Customer Care Project & SRS Coordinator who will play a key role in ensuring the smooth execution of customer projects from quotation through delivery. Acting as the link between multiple internal stakeholders, this person will help drive operational excellence while ensuring an outstanding customer experience.

 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Serving customers across a wide range of sectors worldwide, the company is known for its high-quality engineered solutions, strong customer focus and commitment to continuous improvement.
The organisation combines the stability of an international group with a collaborative and people-oriented culture. Employees are encouraged to grow professionally while working in a dynamic and multicultural environment.

• Coordinate projects in collaboration with Customer Care, Project Coordination and Engineering teams.

• Ensure excellent customer service by adhering to established processes and best practices.
• Support customers by analysing requests, questions and operational challenges.
• Assist in customer care improvement initiatives and training-related projects.

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Experience working with ERP systems is considered an advantage.
• Customer-focused with excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Comfortable working cross-functionally in an international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a strong asset.
• Flexible mindset and willingness to occasionally travel.

Our client is looking for a Customer Training & Development Specialist to design, deliver and continuously improve learning initiatives within a customer-facing environment. This role combines training delivery, coaching and learning programme development to support employee growth and operational excellence.

 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a globally recognised industrial organisation with a strong reputation for innovation, operational excellence and customer-centricity. With an international footprint and a collaborative culture, the company invests heavily in employee development and continuous learning.
Employees benefit from a dynamic working environment where knowledge sharing, professional growth and teamwork are highly valued, creating opportunities to build a rewarding long-term career.

 

Omschrijving

• Partner with management to identify training needs and develop tailored learning solutions.
• Design, create and continuously improve training materials, manuals, guides and digital learning content.
• Deliver engaging training sessions for both new hires and existing employees.
• Evaluate training effectiveness and implement improvements where needed.
• Maintain training records and monitor employee learning progress.
• Provide individual coaching and ongoing support to customer service professionals.
• Support the implementation of learning and development initiatives across the organisation.
• Research and introduce modern training methodologies and best practices.
• Contribute to various projects related to employee development and organisational learning.
• Travel occasionally to other company sites to facilitate training sessions.
 

• Master's degree in Business, Education, Human Resources or a related field.

• Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
• Proven ability to adapt training approaches to different audiences and topics.
• Experience developing learning content and training programmes.
• Familiarity with e-learning platforms and digital learning tools is an advantage.
• Excellent organisational and time management skills.
• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to motivate and engage others.
• Ability to work independently while thriving in a collaborative environment.
• Fluent in English.
• Willingness to travel occasionally when required

For our client in the Kortrijk region, we are looking for a motivated Carpet Finishing Operator to strengthen our team on the finishing line.

 

• Cutting and finishing carpets to size

• Processing carpets on the finishing line

• Carrying out quality checks

• Attaching fringes when necessary

• Applying labels to carpets

• Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish

Job Requirements:

• You are precise and enjoy working with your hands

• You have an eye for quality and attention to detail

• You can work independently, but you are also a team player

• Experience in carpets, textiles or garment manufacturing is a plus

• Experience is not required: motivation and a positive work attitude are important

• You speak Dutch, French or English

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily production process of personalized cell therapy, both for clinical and commercial purposes. You will lead various units within the CAR-T process and ensure safe and compliant production activities in accordance with cGMP requirements — all while coordinating and overseeing operations from your dedicated office workspace, maintaining a clear overview of the production floor and ensuring smooth cross-team collaboration.

Tasks:
	
• Lead and supervise operational units within the CAR-T production process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.	
• Act as the primary point of contact for production-related topics, ensuring smooth coordination with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.	
• Provide hands-on leadership on the shop floor, supporting teams in daily operations, troubleshooting, and decision-making in cGMP environments.	
• Serve as a subject matter expert for Quality and Operations and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.	
• Oversee production quality activities, including documentation management (procedures, work instructions, logs, transfer forms), batch record review and release, and compliance with cGMP standards.	
• Coordinate quality system processes such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.	
• Guide and support team development through structured training and operational coaching.	
• Drive operational excellence by leading process improvements focused on efficiency, cost reduction, and quality enhancement.

Who we are looking for: 
	
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.	
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a production environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma.	
• Strong experience in management, for example as a production lead, supervisor, or similar leadership role.	
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations, cleanroom operations, and familiarity with Microsoft Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus.	
• Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills with an empathetic and people-oriented management style.	
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with a strong attention to detail.	
• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Team Lead, you will be responsible for the daily production of personalized cell therapies for both clinical and commercial use in a sterile cGMP environment. You will coordinate the different units within the CAR-T process and ensure that all activities are carried out safely and in full compliance with cGMP requirements — while steering and organizing the operations from your office-based workspace, keeping a strong overview of the production flow and acting as the central point of coordination for the team.

If you don't have prior leadership experience yet, that is also okay. If you have solid GMP  experience (ideally in production or close to production) and you naturally take ownership, coordinate smoothly, and feel comfortable guiding others, we strongly encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities:
	
• Coordinate and supervise operational units within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.	
• Act as the first point of contact for production issues and collaborate closely with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.	
• Serve as a domain expert for Quality and Operations in cGMP environments and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.	
• Manage all quality-related production aspects, including procedures, work instructions, logbooks, transfer forms, batch record review and release, and overall cGMP compliance.	
• Coordinate quality system activities such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.	
• Ensure proper training of team members and promote a culture of continuous learning.	
• Drive operational excellence by initiating improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall quality.

Who we are looking for: 
	
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.	
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma. 	
• Experience in people management, or with relatable coordinating activities such as training, coaching, ... .	
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations and cleanroom operations; familiarity with Microsoft Office is required, and experience with MES/EBR is a plus.	
• Strong communication and organizational skills. You don’t need formal leadership experience, but you do show natural leadership qualities:	
• you take ownership	
• you guide and support others confidently	
• you keep oversight and work in a structured way	
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with strong attention to detail.	
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

Our client is an internationally active company within the food industry, known for its entrepreneurial mindset, strong customer focus, and ambitious growth plans. With a family-oriented culture and a fast-moving business environment, they offer employees the opportunity to take ownership, drive results, and contribute to long-term success.

Jobomschrijving

• Identify and develop new business opportunities in international markets.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
• Manage the entire sales process, from prospecting to closing deals.
• Conduct commercial negotiations and follow up on opportunities.
• Expand market presence and grow the customer portfolio.
• Monitor market developments and identify growth opportunities.
• Analyse sales results and customer needs.
• Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure excellent customer service.
• Report on sales activities and contribute to commercial strategy.

• Fluent in German and/or Portuguese, with a good command of English.
• Previous experience in sales, business development, customer relations, or a commercial role.
• Strong commercial awareness and a results-driven approach.
• Comfortable with prospecting and developing new business.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
• Proactive, self-motivated, and eager to learn.
• Able to work independently while contributing to a team environment.
• Thrives in a fast-paced and international setting.
• Affinity with the food sector is an asset.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.

Security wereld in België en Nederland. 

Jobomschrijving

Reporting and service data management:
•    Provide timely and accurate reporting based on service tickets.
•    Search, verify and consolidate the relevant information contained in tickets.
•    Prepare SLA reports, KPI reports, dashboards and clear management information.
•    Ensure the quality, completeness, consistency and currency of reporting data.
Reporting process improvement and automation:
•    Improve and automate the current reporting processes, which are still partly manual.
•    Use advanced Microsoft Excel functionalities to optimize data processing and reporting.
•    Identify automation opportunities using Power Automate and, where relevant, VBA.
•    Maintain dashboards and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Service Delivery support:
•    Support the Services Delivery team with administrative and analytical tasks.
•    Translate operational data into accurate and understandable information for internal stakeholders and management.
•    Organize and prioritize tasks independently, while respecting reporting deadlines and quality requirements.
•    Take on other related tasks when required, while reporting remains the priority of the role.
KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
•    Timely delivery of SLA and management reports.
•    Accuracy and quality of reporting data.
•    Level of automation achieved in reporting processes.
•    Availability and currency of dashboards.
•    Internal customer satisfaction regarding reporting.
•    Number and quality of identified improvement initiatives.
 

Education, Knowledge & Work Experience:
•    Relevant higher education or ongoing studies in office management, business management, administration, data analysis or a related field.
•    Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, advanced formulas, data modelling and dashboarding.
•    Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis.
•    Experience with KPI development, SLA reporting and data quality management is an asset.
•    Knowledge of ITIL processes and experience with CMDB environments are assets.
•    Experience with Power Automate, VBA, Grafana or similar tools is an asset.
Required skills:
•    Strong analytical mindset and administrative accuracy.
•    Structured way of working and excellent attention to detail.
•    Ability to work independently and to prioritize tasks.
•    Results-oriented and quality-focused approach.
•    Excellent written communication skills.
•    Ability to translate data into clear management information.
•    Proactive attitude and focus on continuous improvement.
Languages:
•    Very good knowledge of Dutch, as communication is mainly internal.
•    Good knowledge of French and English is an asset.

Our client is an international company active in the medical devices sector, with a strong focus on dialysis solutions, representing the majority of its revenue.

The organization operates a global supply chain, with most products manufactured in Asia and additional production sites in Europe (Germany and Spain). The European headquarters manages distribution across EMEA, working closely with multiple 3PL warehouse partners.

Jobomschrijving

As a Freelance Inventory Planner your responsibilities are:

• Manage and optimize inventory levels across multiple European warehouses.
• Monitor stock levels, overstock, shortages and expiry risks, ensuring availability and cost efficiency.
• Act as the main point of cobntact for 3PL partners, coordinating inbound and outbound flows.
• Collaborate closely with demand planning teams to align forecasts and anticipate supply risks.
• Support the opening of new warehouses (Spain, Italy) and ensure alignment with internal processes.
• Ensure inventory accuracy, including stock reconciliation and cycle counts.
• Follow up daily operations to guarantee product availability and service levels.
• Contribute to process improvements and standardization across EMEA supply chain operations.

A successful Freelance Inventory Planner should have:

• Proven experience as Inventory Planner, Supply Planner or similar role.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to manage complex inventory flows.
• Experience working with 3PL logistics providers and warehouse operations.
• Ability to quickly adapt and build relationships with stakeholders in an international environment.
• Advanced Excel skills (data analysis, templates, reporting).
• Fluent in English, Italian or Spanish are a plus

Our client is a well-established presence in its field, known for operating with a steady and understated professionalism. It focuses on delivering consistent value while adapting quietly to evolving market needs.

For the Finance team they are looking for a new Treasury Analyst.

Jobomschrijving

• Track daily cash balances and collections across accounts
• Execute and verify inter-account cash transfers
• Manage daily outgoing payments (suppliers, urgent transactions)
• Validate reports, reconciliations, and allocation flows
• Ensure accurate and timely investor-grade reporting
• Apply and maintain standardized reporting frameworks
• Improve treasury processes for scalability, control, and automation
